name: Might Makes Right
summary: Clugfist challenges you to prove your strength in Bolder'ok. Twilight's Hammer ogres are the test.

sections.title: Clugfist's Test
sections.body: Clugfist judges strength by blood, and sends you against the Twilight Maulers and Twilight Firecallers in Bolder'ok. He doubts your size, yet gives you the chance to show what you can do. The challenge puts your strength against the Twilight ogres.

faq.answer: Clugfist is the ogre in Bolder'ok who challenges you to prove your strength.

faq.q: What does Clugfist want me to do?
faq.answer: Clugfist asks you to kill Twilight Maulers and Twilight Firecallers in Bolder'ok.
Clugfist calls you tiny and questions whether you are strong.
Bolder'ok is where Clugfist says ogres value strength and blood.

attribution: In-game quest text: Might Makes Right
